scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: Club survey: pasta or rice? Soup or salad? The results will be very scientific… and very tasty!
scene.intro: Club survey! Erik walks around with a notebook: pasta or rice? Soup or salad? Mateo likes everything and answers yes to every question, which is not very useful for a survey. I like cheese but I don't like soup, says Erik, writing it down. And the milkshake? Everybody likes the milkshake. What do you like? What don't you like? Answer the survey and count the votes!

data.script: Erik: Food survey, question one! Mateo, pasta or rice? … Mateo: Pasta! With lots of cheese on top. … Erik: Valentina says soup, because her grandma makes the best chicken soup. … Erik: Sofia likes salad with eggs and olives. … Erik: And I like sausages with mashed potato. Engineer food! … Mateo: What about Luna? … Erik: Luna voted with her tail: she likes meat. Big surprise! … Erik: Final result: everything is tasty when the Club eats together!
